verdict.rationale: Unleash Edge is a documented caching and relay layer. It acts as a read replica serving thousands of connected SDKs, and targeting data (user IDs, emails, IPs) is processed within the Edge node, which implies flag evaluation happens at the edge layer rather than upstream. Backend tokens connect Edge to the main instance. Missing for 10: any evidence of running evaluation inside CDN workers, explicit documentation of placing Edge nodes geographically close to users, clarity on whether this is limited to the Enterprise tier, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
